Cosmere.Scadrial.Def.AllomanticAbilityDe.label: compound nicrosil
Cosmere.Scadrial.Def.AllomanticAbilityDe.description: Compounding nicrosil leaves the soul hollow. The power within fades, connections dim, and Investiture slips away — all to store the essence of magic itself. With enough loss, the metalmind becomes a vessel of unimaginable potential.
